title: No-Bake Coco Balls
description: Rich, tropical petit-fours made from dark chocolate, pitted dates and desiccated coconut — rolled into balls and drizzled with melted chocolate. No baking required.
steps: Weigh out half the chocolate and chop into chunks. Put in a food processor with the dates and coconut. Blitz until the mixture comes together into a crumbly ball.
Roll small balls (50p-piece size) between your palms and place on greaseproof paper.
Melt the remaining chocolate in the microwave in 20-second bursts. Allow to cool slightly.
Transfer cooled chocolate to a piping bag (or drizzle from a spoon) and drizzle over the coco balls.
Once the chocolate has set, put in paper petit-four cases to serve.
